title: Impact: hitstop, mass, material, audio
brief: dispatch message (no brief file); docs/PLAN.md §3 W1-11 entry
findings: SURVEY-1 (hitstop/material ALREADY BUILT by W1-10 rounds 1-3): game/src/combat/impact.js exists (173 lines), exports resolveImpact() reading game/data/weapons/classes.json ON THE FRAME OF THE HIT, consumed by game/src/combat/resolve.js (the fight) and game/src/combat/moveset.js (harness accessors). W1-10-r2 GAP `GAP-W1-weapon-impact-and-material-model-has-no-consumer` is CLOSED: W1-10-r3 verdict records `impact/material consumed 6/6 behavioural with silent controls`. Do NOT redo this.

SURVEY-2 (what W1-10-r3 left BROKEN and is squarely `weapon.feel.mass`, MY path): peak tip speeds of 200.9 / 189.5 / 160.3 / 144.7 / 137.5 m/s against RI-WPN05 §E's WIDEST band ceiling of 40 m/s (ultra) — a factor of five. The weapon tip is BELOW THE FLOOR on 13%-68% of every trace's frames, reaching -2.83 m. RI-WPN05 scored ladder 4. This is the largest un-owned defect inside my declared paths.

SURVEY-3 (audio.combat.impact is ZERO): RI-AUD01 scores 0 fail-closed (`Unimplemented audio scores 0, not not-assessed`). No combat audio exists anywhere. W1-22 has built game/src/audio/synth.js + ambience.js for `audio.ambience.region` ONLY.

SURVEY-4 (SEAM with W1-22, resolved): W1-22 owns game/src/audio/ambience.js and game/data/audio/ambience/*.json (13 region beds, already written). synth.js is a SHARED PRIMITIVE LIBRARY (dbToGain, makeNoiseBuffer, buildGrain, buildContinuous) written against BaseAudioContext. I will IMPORT synth.js and add my own files (game/src/audio/impact-audio.js, game/data/audio/impact/*.json) rather than edit theirs.

SURVEY-5 (materials ARE authored): game/data/combat/enemies/ now contains mat_flesh/mat_chitin/mat_stone/mat_metal/mat_shield/mat_water/mat_plant dummies plus real statblocks declaring `material`. The W1-10-r2 finding `0 of 14 statblocks declares a material` is stale.

SURVEY-6 (offline render path exists): game/src/engine.js:4221 already resolves globalThis.OfflineAudioContext / webkitOfflineAudioContext and returns {ok:false, why:...} when absent. engine.js:4205 exposes ambienceLog(). An impact audio log needs the sibling accessor.

SURVEY-7 (THE HOOK): game/src/combat/system.js:278 defines a single closure  through which EVERY combat event passes, inside CombatSystem.step, in the same call stack as the geometry decision. Hooking it makes RI-AUD01 §B  true BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by scheduling luck. One file, one place.

SURVEY-8 (event vocabulary already carries everything impact audio needs): resolve.js emits PARRY, DEFLECT, BLOCK, GUARD_BREAK, BLOCK_SUCCESS, HIT, STAGGER, WHIFF, DEATH, IMPACT. The IMPACT event (resolve.js:370 emitImpact) already carries {material, impact_row, tier, damage_type, hitstop_f, victim_hitstop_f, knockback_m, deflect, decal, shake_deg, part, via, dmg}. That is the exact (tier x material) join RI-AUD01 §A needs to pick between C01/C02/C03.
SURVEY-9 (reusable primitives, no seam violation): game/src/audio/synth.js exports dbToGain, gainToDb, makeNoiseBuffer, buildContinuous, buildGrain — all written against BaseAudioContext, all W1-22s.
SURVEY-10 (PRNG): game/src/core/rng.js exports class Rng (splitmix32 seeded, xoshiro-ish). Same one ambience uses. Variant selection must use it for RI-AUD01 M9 determinism.
next_step: author game/data/audio/impact/classes.json (12 classes, gain table, >=4 variants, synth specs), then game/src/audio/impact-audio.js
notes_for_successor: This piece is NOT a green field. W1-10 built and got credit for hitstop+material consumption. The two real holes are (a) weapon.feel.mass — tip speeds 5x the band, tip below floor — and (b) audio.combat.impact — literally zero. Prioritise (b) then (a); (b) is a hard 0 that caps RI-AUD01 and RI-AUD02.
